secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key used by the AI Class / MCQ / transcription routes (@google/genai). Create one at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. Optional for boot - without it those routes return their built-in offline fallback.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional master password for the teacher/admin management panel (app/api/admin/verify). Falls back to the in-app default when unset.
